purpose: Capture C++ ChangeDendriteStatus decision at first divergent PHASE6 iteration using native RDK JSON sink

logging.why: Train/EventsLog was absent and standard GLog file output failed; native JSON sink writes C++ decisions directly

exit_state.termination: -t 14 model-time cap; not C++ convergence/refusal; process exited and autosaved at model time limit

iteration_6_decision.consequence: length change for active dendrite skipped at iteration 6

interpretation: The exact-zero physical delay computes as a tiny negative double. The strict sign guard takes its invalid-delay path; because active L=9 exceeds the final reference L=1, the fallback does not set DendStatus to grow. This explains the iteration-6 no-growth decision in the 1.55 s cadence run. The paired 1.50 s control grows the same dendrite at iteration 6; it does not capture its DelayFromPulse, so the cadence-dependent sign-boundary mechanism is the best-supported explanation but remains to be tested with a tolerance-only C++ control. No full convergence claim: Need=1 at the time cap.
